verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is one first-party marketing line saying Bitbucket offers 'AI-powered search' across the development lifecycle. It does not say that search covers code or spans multiple repositories. The community complaint about not being able to browse or search public projects by language is about project discovery, not code search, so it does not create a concrete dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that search indexes code content, cross-repository scope, query features (filters, language, path, regex), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search code across repositories

citations.quote: Reduce cycle times across the development lifecycle with AI-powered search, chat, code review, pipeline triage, and even Jira updates.
